demos.userQuery: Hey, I need to write an email regarding a parental leave.
demos.modelExampleResponses:
Certainly! Here’s a sample email template for notifying your employer about your parental leave. You can customize it based on your specific situation and preferences.

---

**Subject:** Parental Leave Notification

Dear [Manager's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to formally inform you that I will be taking parental leave, effective [start date], due to the arrival of my [son/daughter]. I am excited to welcome this new addition to my family and appreciate your understanding during this time.

I plan to take [number of weeks/months] off, returning to work on [return date]. I will ensure that my responsibilities are managed smoothly before my leave begins. I am currently working on transitioning my tasks and will provide an update on the progress by [specific date].

Please let me know if there is any additional documentation you need from my side or if we should schedule a time to discuss this further.

Thank you for your support and understanding. I look forward to returning to the team after my leave.

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Job Title]  
[Your Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust any sections as needed to better reflect your situation!
